items.briefing:
Scammers are increasingly targeting Australians through phishing attacks, with two notable threats active right now. A phishing service is impersonating RingCentral communications software to steal Microsoft 365 login credentials — if you receive an unexpected RingCentral email asking you to sign in, do not click the link. Separately, so-called "device code phishing" attacks have surged 1,500% this year globally, where scammers trick users into approving fake login requests on their devices. Gambling and betting scams are also being flagged by Scamwatch as an ongoing concern for Australians.

Stay alert to any unsolicited emails or messages asking you to verify account access, even if they appear to come from familiar brands. **Practical tip:** Before clicking any login link in an email, go directly to the website by typing the address into your browser instead.
